'''Xuvvas''' were hairless, [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] flying creatures, that were distant cousins to the [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]]. Like mynocks, xuvvas also leeched electrical energy from power sources, but their diet also included living prey. They possessed pointy teeth, swollen stomachs, and horn-like antenna with sensitive electroreceptors for finding their quarry. A single xuvva could be deadly enough to kill a trained hunter, while a flock was said to be able to devour prey the size of a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in minutes.<ref name="codex" />

Xuvvas were most prominent on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="TOR" /> but have also spread to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]],<ref name="Secrets">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref> and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="KotET:II">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=2}}</ref> In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}</ref> xuvva [[Fuzzy (Xuvva)|Fuzzy]] accompanied [[zeldrate]] [[Ol' Cronchy]] and [[Skar'kla]] [[Yug]], by a lake in the vicinity of Dantooine's [[Jedi Enclave]]. The three were [[Yarvok]]'s beloved pets, and they were fed by the [[Alliance Commander]]'s crew as the [[Eternal Alliance]] strike team made its way into the Enclave.<ref name="Secrets" />
